Name: DE-EstimatesQuotesMonthCount
Description: Gets the count of estimate quotes for the given filters.
Statement:
select	count(*) as [Count]
from 	Estimate est
            join EstimateItem eit on eit.Estimate = est.Oid
            join EstimateItemDetail eid on eit.Oid = eid.EstimateItem
            left join EstimateItemDetailMonth edm on edm.EstimateItemDetail = eid.Oid
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = est.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
where	wst.Status not in (1, 7) and
        (@EstimateId is null or est.Oid = @EstimateId) and
        (@EstimateNumber is null or est.Number = cast(@EstimateNumber as nvarchar))
